title: Church Cosplay—And The Cost of Pretending to Believe

top_liked.author: @somersetcace1
top_liked.text: One of the strongest parts of this video for me is the way you describe the cost of pretending. That quiet psychological drain of feeling like you have to perform certainty, suppress doubts, or go along with something because the consequences of breaking character could mean…

top_liked.author: @schnellster1
top_liked.text: Astonishingly, none of the musicians orchestrating the whole seance never get overtaken by the holy Ghost!!! 😂😂😂😂😂...it's like the cameraman never dies!!!

top_liked.author: @hughmann1118
top_liked.text: In my church, we had the "Baptism of the Holy Spirit", in which the elders would swarm you and speak in tongues and not let you go until you pretended to speak in tongues too. That's when I smelled a rat, which led to my rejection of Christianity.

top_liked.author: @garrystahl8340
top_liked.text: Those that can get you to believe absurdities, can get you to commit atrocities. -- Voltaire

top_liked.author: @raptorcrasherinc.9823
top_liked.text: When I converted at 18, I had to throw out a lot of what I knew about science, and I had to make allowances for God being a monster, when I would call out anyone I knew. I am glad I did not spend much of my life as a Christian.

top_liked.author: @aprilswill9204
top_liked.text: My religious family prayed for me while I supported my father alone. Prayer was their contribution. When I asked their actions to align with their beliefs, suddenly I was the problem. Turns out accountability is more uncomfortable than prayer.

top_liked.author: @medusarising
top_liked.text: You put into words the thoughts and feelings I've had but never been able to articulate myself.

top_liked.author: @MphoMokoena-t2v
top_liked.text: I realise that Christians are pretending, when the church I was attending, people including the pastor would say that God spoke to them, like literally....

top_liked.author: @SapientCephalopod
top_liked.text: I had been out of the church for decades before I realized I was an atheist. Luckily I never had to pretend.

top_liked.author: @edbeastgaming
top_liked.text: “Fake it till you make it” was a real thing I heard. I traded faith for honesty.

top_discussed.author: @JimTeal3rd
top_discussed.text: The last few sands of belief slipped through my fingers this year, at age 44. 35 years of my life dedicated to sustaining an illusion, and then to recovering it and rebuilding it when I realized it was slipping away from me. Grief for the time wasted indeed.
